newsitem.title: USA: Senator challenges USDA employee buyout scheme.
newsitem.headline: Senator challenges USDA employee buyout scheme.

text.p: U.S. Senate Agriculture Committee Chairman Richard Lugar said Wednesday USDA proposals to shift $43 million in conservation resources to an employee buyout scheme would undermine farm conservation efforts.
Lugar, a Republican from Indiana, said USDA was considering shifting the money from unexpended Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) funds to provide bonuses to employees willing to retire early.

"The unexpended CRP funds -- which would continue to be available in succeeding fiscal years -- could be used to provide technical assistance to farmers and ranchers, or to enrol environmentally beneficial land in the CRP," Lugar said.
Lugar made the remarks in a letter to Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman, a statement from Lugar's office said.
